pages.title: Using the Remedy
pages.text: Right-click an intact owned dragon statue with the remedy. Untamed, ownerless human-form dragon statues can also be restored.

pages.title: Brewing the Remedy
pages.text: Brew mundane potions with a Gorgon's head and blaze powder. One head makes up to three. No gunpowder: apply to statues; do not drink or throw.

pages.title: After Restoration
pages.text: Name, growth, knowledge, equipment, accessories, and stored items remain. The remedy does not heal existing injuries, so continue caring for your companion.$(br2)Leave room for it to appear; the remedy is consumed only on success. Read $(l:dragonmaid:care/injury#petrification)Reversing Petrification$(/l) for details.
